notes.title: Real Boxing™ just got better!
notes.content:
Download Update 1.1 now and enjoy:

[b]NEW LANGUAGE LOCALIZATIONS:[/b] enjoy the true boxing experience on Steam, now also available in Traditional and Simplified Chinese, and more!
